articleTitle: Verbal aggression as a communication strategy in digital society
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: Verbal aggression has emerged as a communication strategy in the digital media space today. However, there is a lack of empirical studies in the context of Russian mass media, especially assessing verbal aggression in online media with quantitative or qualitative content-analysis. This study addresses this gap in research literature. The authors have collected data of 164 posts and 38416 comments from the web-site of “Echo of Moscow” in 2014 on the topic of the Ukraine crisis. The crisis was observed in the posts by means of binary opposition “we” versus “they”. The content analysis carried out by the authors revealed that only 17.07% of posts do not contain verbal aggression. Verbal aggression usually includes insulting rhetorics, discreditation of opponents, prosecuting, blaming, threatening, negative forecasting, etc.

articleTitle: Distance learning as a communication strategy for educational environment formation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: Distance learning system in the higher education institutions is one of the most important communication platforms these days. Modern level of development of information and communication technologies lays the foundation for a global distance learning system that helps people create an open education environment without borders. The authors of the article suggest a model of a universal system for evaluation of quality of distance learning in the world. The system includes evaluation criteria for goal — setting, content, organizational and technical setup and results. The proposed model was tested from 2008 to 2017 in the Nizhny Novgorod Linguistic university. The proposed model is considered as a strategy for distant formation of competences that is treated as the main result of education. The authors analyze conditions for various stages of key competences formation in advertising and public relations. This helps students create their own educational strategy and plan their professional development.

articleTitle: The problem of sense creation in interpersonal communication of youth in the digital age
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The processes of sense formation are connected with human selfcommunication, which is often a reflection of interpersonal dialogue. Personal meanings born in the process of communication can be of two types: connected with the subject of communication, and connected with the communication act itself. Analyzing acts of virtual communication for the development of new relationships in it, without guarantees of the authenticity of the subjects, is impossible, and therefore it is only expedient to analyze virtual communication from the point of view of the development of the subject of communication in it. The article analyzes episodes of interpersonal communication in social networks, thematically related to culture, politics, worldview problems. The following indicators serve as criteria for their content: the seriousness of the declared topic of communication; the concreteness of the questions posed; duration of discussion of the topic; deviation from common stereotypes; the reasoning of self opinion.

articleTitle: The physical base of communication on natural language
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The goal of this paper is to shed light on the physical basement of communication in case of natural languages, which is just an assumption in trying to understand why words exist and are organized while Digital Society is going to replace them by artificial electronic models. The natural language is considered to be positioned on two well-known physical levels - Newtonian and Quantum mechanics. The formation of word (a portion of sound, having a portion of meaning) is thought to happen on the quantum level, while the arrangement of words and word complexes is believed to take place on the classical mechanical level. The notion of semifinitive is introduced and developed to cover the categories of time, space, mass and energy as the categories, constituting the most parts of a language, which have concern to verbal and substantive units to be considered aconsidereds being profound communication units.

articleTitle: Communicative capitaland communicative exploitation in digital society
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The paper deals with the concept of communicative capitalism as a theoretical framework for analyzing contradictions of digital society. We consider an attention-keeping as a basis for Internet users exploitation and, consequently, for an accumulation of a new type of capital, which is called communicative. In virtual space, inequality in the distribution of communicative capital constitutes a new hierarchy of “exploiters” and “exploited”. The first ones are creators of digital spectacle using their recourses to compete for mass attention. The second ones are spectators involved in “presuming” of circulating data flow; in other words, they are communicative laborers. We highlight a new dimension of power applying in computer-mediated networks. Also, we identify new instrumental and discursive practices communicative capitalists use for attracting Internet users' attention, retaining it, and making the process of its monetization routinized and predictable. Such capitalists can furtherly reinvest received money to dominate both economically and politically.

articleTitle: Government communication strategies of global city: Opportunities and risks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is the study of government communication strategy in St Petersburg as a global city. The global city status is considered to be desired and beneficial bringing much needed sustainable development in digital society. Political engagement and government administration are named among main parameters to reach the status (Sassen; O'Connor; Florida; Kearney; etc). In this research the authors make an attempt to indicate the essential characteristics of the government public relations in St Petersburg combining three methods: experts' interview, document analysis, and opinion poll. The paper discusses results of the study revealing existing tendencies of St Petersburg current communication strategy as a global city.

articleTitle: The use of new technologies by women in politics in the 2018 elections in Russia and Colombia
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The purpose of the research is to identify the most effective and utilized digital platform employed by women in politics in Colombia and in Russia to connect with people and disseminate their political ideas. The objective is to show how platforms like Facebook, Twitter, blogs, and others have transformed the historically established relationships between the target audience and traditional media, and how this new order influences the political and social reality of the country in a positive and negative way. This has been done by analyzing and comparing the use of Twitter and blogs by presidential candidates Ksenya Sobchak from Russia and Claudia Lopez from Colombia for the 2018 presidential elections that will take place in both countries.

articleTitle: Communication strategies in public service advertising
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The study develops the bipolarity theory of communication strategies in public service advertising; as well it reveals technologies of positive and negative propaganda in the text of public service advertising.

articleTitle: Synesthesia and virtual communication: Aesthetic approaches to research
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: In the paper the problem of the crisis of modern aesthetic theory related to the problems of the general aesthetization and virtualization of the surrounding reality is considered. Modern processes of the derealization of life and multiplicity of the reality's perception related to the development of virtual communication, point out for the development of a new type of aesthetics which problematic could be defined on the basis of a synesthetic paradigm. The possibilities for using synesthesia in printed, audio and video advertising are analyzed. The article presents the results of the study of synesthesia in the art of advertising, obtained on the basis of empirical research.

articleTitle: Multimedia tools and the latest technologies in the advertising and communicative space
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The article examines the phenomenon of the multimedia influence on the development of advertising on the Internet, describes in detail the technology for designing the future media industry - foresight and represents the modern tools of a converged specialist.

articleTitle: Communication strategies of megacities in the new digital reality
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The context of the network society, glokalization and the rapid development of digital technologies contribute to the emergence of mega-cities brands acting on the basis on the new digital communications reality. Digital city branding is realized by an interplay of the multitude of actors both institutional and non-institutional. As a result, territorial brands are created with the participation of digital stakeholders. Prominent scholars: F. Kotler, M. Kavaratzis, K. Deanie, A. Middleton and others note the urgent need to rethink the communicative strategies of the megalopolises and the role of digital stakeholders of territorial entities in the network society. Stakeholders should be seen as an active group of communicative actors who can motivate and involve in the process of building a city brand. The article analyzes the features, technologies and methods of interaction with stakeholders in the process of building a territorial brand in conditions of the digital society.

articleTitle: Brand communication tools transformation in digital society
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: Nowadays the world is very actively changing and online digital communications are becoming more and more significant. The Internet can offer many opportunities and instruments, but it is also possible to observe the phenomenon of traditional communication tools transformation in the digital space, where instruments are implemented online. This transformation of the brand forming communication tools in digital society is considered in the article.

articleTitle: Communication models in the E-learning environment based on intelligent agents
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The last decades of innovations diffusion in the computer technology, transformed the practice of academic education. Analysis of Learning Management System (LMS) in education shows the need to reorient learning process to meet student's individual needs in digital society. During the analyzation of the prospects e-learning systems, we saw an important need to include personal intellectual agents, whose main role are to help regulate student's success academic level and communication strategies in education. The main goal of our work is consider communication models in e-learning environment based on intelligent agents. Accompanying the students in training requires an analysis their target audience, throughout the basis of requirements that the agent will determined. We consider training IT specialists, whose competences are based on a wide range of professional qualities. A comparative analysis of mixed communication model (blended-learning), the traditional model, and model of communication in the e-learning environment is carried out.

articleTitle: Development of the “Open Science” principles and using alternative metrics in digital scientific communication in Russia
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The article considers Russian examples of scientific digital communications in the format of “Open Science”. Goals of these communications are to make the results of scientific research accessible to all interested groups: government, business, academic community, and introduction of alternative metrics in assessing the effectiveness of scientific projects.

articleTitle: Advertising in popular instant messengers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The article discusses the relevance of the use of instant messengers Viber, WhatsApp, Telegram in the advertising field, as well as the phenomenon of hybrid forms of advertising.

articleTitle: Digital platforms as a tool for transforming mass media communication strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: Approaches to the use of digital platforms by public organs and federal agencies (such as FAS), on the one hand, and sports media (exemplified by “championat.ru”), on the other, are compared in the paper. Using digital platforms (Vkontakte, Odnoklassniki, Twitter, Facebook) by the government authorities enables to close the gap in communication and to bounce over to a dialogue with the audience that ensures feedback in communication. Granting fast step-by-step access to the reference documents determines their extensive use by wide audience, and allows for discussing issues on legislation and lawmaking in the media discourse. Digital instruments affect the transformation of the genres of sports journalism; forms of presentation of the material through emphasizing a visual component are changed; and multifunctionality of sports media texts is manifested in the integration of various genres.

articleTitle: Assessment of quality characteristics of television systems for the organization of communication in digital society
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: In this article assessment techniques of qualitative characteristics of television systems depending on type of the television sensor “light signal” are offered. Types of the television sensors used in different television systems are considered. Scopes of the appropriate television systems are given. The analysis of the existing assessment models of the qualitative characteristics using as the television sensor CCD and the CMOS array is carried out. Analytical models of assessment of sensitivity and illuminance of television systems on CMOS and CCD for valuation methods enhancement of the quantitative characteristics of television sensors on CMOS and CCD are provided. In analytical models influence of parameters of a lens on qualitative characteristics of television systems is considered. The fields of application of models for quality assessment of the television systems applied in application-oriented and measuring television in processes of digital society communication are offered.

articleTitle: Communication strategies as a way of forming the image of commercial organizations
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The content of communication strategies in commercial organizations is revealed on the material of the Internet sites of PAO “Sberbank” and PAO “VTB Group”, the positive image is shown.

articleTitle: An operational model situation in ensuring availability of information security through the help of satellite communication infrastructures in digital society
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: This article describes different methods of processing signals which are being hindered through the cause of a satellite communication system. Although Digital Satellite communication is cost effective solution for such long distance communication application. However, the security over the link is still a major concern in satellite communication. Due to limitations such as high bit error rate, power control, large distance between end nodes, high link delays because of large round trip times, and link availability, common security techniques incorporate a lot of issues in implementation of proper secure Information over the satellite links. In this survey paper, we explore the importance of Information security, trivial and currently deployed security tools to measure the signal-noise ratio through the help of a special device which gives rooms for wave's polarization.

articleTitle: Medialization of linguistic knowledge in the modern digital space: A case study of the project “The faces of the modern Russian Studies”
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The research focuses on medialization of linguistic knowledge in modern Russia. Contemporary digital space is lacking the content dedicated to research issues. Against this background, it seems important not only to increase the amount of information reflecting the activities of the leading Russian scholars, but also to choose effective digital channels used to transfer this information. The media project “The faces of the modern Russian Studies” can be considered a positive example of creating a TV and radio production that allows to deals with this problem.

articleTitle: Specific features of the communication strategy of sports brands promotion in social networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The study presents the analysis of the social marketing communication tools used to position and promote sports brands. Since sports products are closely associated with sports as a social value system, it is obvious that advertising and public relations specialists turn to social marketing potential that allow to combine smoothly commercial goals with socially oriented activities. According to the analysis of sports brands accounts, messages of a socially oriented nature take almost a third of all posts, which allows companies to promote not only their own products, but also socially significant values such as healthy lifestyle, healthy attitude towards your body. The main trend of positioning activity in social networks is the hybridization of the used genres, suggesting a combination of advertising and socially oriented genres that allows to hide the advertising message, as well as to veil its manipulative nature.

articleTitle: Political mythologization in a digital environment as a communicative strategy of candidate image formation during election period
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: This article deals with the study of myths in political communication and level's specification of mythological impact on political image construction. The authors propose to distinguish “internal mythologization” when a politician with a team are considered to be a source of mythmaking, and “external mythologization”initiated by non-affiliated representatives of different socialgroups. It is concerned with “internal mythologization” as a communicative strategy for constructing a politician's image during election period and analyses the representation features of four main political myths(social ideal, enemy, identity community and hero-saviour) in communication of one of the new leaders of Russia's political agenda and the Communist Party's candidate for the 2018 presidential election Pavel Grudinin. Much attention is given to the identification of verbal and visual means, through which these political myths are explicated in election videos, as well as the definition of emotional-evaluative connotations that can influence the construction of political image.

articleTitle: Role of artistic communicative strategies in modern day politics
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Workshop (ComSDS)
abstract: The paper refers to the problem of constructing modern day political leaders' communication with the voters. The peculiarities of convergent communication, which is inseparable from modern day communication, allow to produce a model of communicative process participants, determine the most significant communicative competencies of convergent participants and offer proper solutions of communicative problems. The authors come to a conclusion that within the framework of the digital society, possessing new channels of communication, new technologies of transferring and storing information etc., the basic communicative strategies, characterizing participants of communication, peculiarities of their consciousness and, consequently, peculiarities of receiving and processing the information, remain unchanged. We also have to admit the unchangeability of discursive strategies considered as primary principles of activity, which can be chosen by a participant. It should also be noted that these strategies can be traced to the archetypical models of behavior of the Headman, King, Judge, Warrior, Teacher, Father, Son etc. New communication channels (social networks, sites of politicians, YouTube channels, messengers etc.), used extensively in modern day politics, aim to change not the strategies, but the discourse formats, corresponding to the communication channels, on the one hand, and possessing the ability to organize dialogical relations between the creator and the recipient, on the other hand. The authors also claim that the chosen communicative strategies should correspond to those archetypes that underlie politician's image and the chosen communicative strategies are not supposed to undermine these archetypes.
